Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@orionbio.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor preflight: required compliance docs and PO path

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro. We're kicking off vendor activation for Redwood as part of our Q1 integrations and need to collect the required procurement and compliance evidence before we can route a PO. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following items within the next 7 business days?

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope
- Penetration test attestation / letter (redacted is OK)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (I attached our standard spreadsheet)
- W-9 (for US tax) and legal entity details for PO
- Preferred PO instructions and billing address / remit-to

Also: (a) do you accept standard Orion vendor terms or will Redwood propose amendments? (b) who at Redwood owns billing/PO routing?

We're the procurement owners at Orion (cc'd). If it helps we can accept redacted SOC material and a short cover note from your security team.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Ops
Orion Biotech

Attachment: Orion_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 92KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -08:00

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver the bulk of those items; below is what I can commit to immediately and the next steps: 

Items we will provide in this thread:
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — security will provide a cover note and redaction by EOD Wed (2027-01-13)
- ISO 27001 certificate (scope: hosted API and Redwood Console) — PDF attached
- Pen test attestation letter — we will provide a signed letter from our security vendor
- W-9 and legal entity info — attached
- PO routing: see attached Redwood_PO_Instructions.docx (billing address, remit-to, contact email for AP)

I attached a short vendor preflight packet that includes our preferred redactions and sensitive-data handling notes. If Orion needs full unredacted artifacts we can arrange an NDA or non-production access.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will upload the SOC/ISO/Pentest artifacts to the Drive link below and share access to Orion procurement.
2) Please confirm if your standard terms are acceptable; if Orion intends to propose redlines, share solicitor contact and we will triage with Legal.
3) I will loop in our security lead (Karthik Iyer) and the account owner (Marissa Cole) for any follow-ups.

I copied both internally. Happy to jump on a short sync if you prefer — 20 minutes should do it.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Preflight_Packet.pdf (pdf, 120KB); Redwood_PO_Instructions.docx (docx, 28KB); Redwood_W9.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orion-preflight

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Orion's intake. Summary and asks: 

- Orion needs SOC2 (redacted OK), ISO cert, pen test letter, completed vendor questionnaire, W-9, and PO routing info.
- I have attached our preflight packet and PO instructions; W-9 already attached to my reply.
- Timeline: they requested items within 7 business days; we can meet that if security provides SOC redaction by EOD Wed.

Karthik — can you: 1) prepare a 1-paragraph cover note to accompany the redacted SOC (we'll upload to drive), and 2) confirm whether the pen test attestation we have from Q4 2026 is acceptable or whether we should obtain an updated letter? Please highlight any items the procurement team might flag (data residency, logging/audit).

Marissa — can you own the PO routing and billing confirmation with Orion? If Orion proposes term redlines we'll need to route to Legal; please flag early. Also estimate whether there is any risk to the renewal/terms if PO is delayed.

I propose a 20-minute sync Tuesday morning if both of you are available; otherwise let's keep email updates.
